events.title: DEMO UPDATE #2
events.summary: NEW MAJOR DEMO UPDATE! I know it's been a minute, but I am back with a big update to the demo! The focus of this update is 3 new gameplay features. COMPANIES, HAZARDS, and PROVISIONS. COMPANIES Companies are passive bonuses you choose before your run. This demo has 2 companies to choose from. Many more companies will release with the full game. events.title: DEMO RELEASE
events.summary: FIRST DEMO RELEASE Today I am releasing the first demo for Moon Drop Miners! The demo is currently a bit light on content, but should have enough to give you an idea of how the game plays and some synergies to explore. I will be updating this demo regularly, adding new structures, satellites, and features. Thanks to anyone who takes the time to try my game!
